title: Tcard_X6885-16.3.0.145SP08-OP004PF001AZ_a15
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6885-16.3.0.145SP08(OP004PF001AZ)

Update Content:
Android Version
Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version
Upgraded from XOS 15 to XOS 16 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

Security
Updated Google Security Patch to August 1, 2026.

AI
1. AI Suggestions: Added three types of service cards—Local, System, and Lifestyle, and optimized transition animations.
2. Improved Chinese speech recognition accuracy, optimized long-text translation logic, and enhanced complex semantic understanding.
3. Improved AI subtitle generation speed with more accurate real-time synchronization for video streams.

New Design
1. Added icon visualization for app download progress.
2. Applied superfluid visuals and smooth animations across the system as well as seamless status bar transitions.
3. Designed seamless expansion animations for Wi-Fi and mobile data cards, with support for hiding switch labels in Control Center.

Multi-Device Connection
1. Cross-device audio casting: Cast phone audio to a same-brand PC or tablet for playback.
2. Communication sync: Sync phone calls and text messages to your PC or tablet in real time.

Privacy
1. Payment protection: Real-time security scans of the device environment when financial apps are launched.
2. Unlock security: Changing your password, fingerprint, or face data now requires privacy password verification.
3. Unified privacy password: Manage all privacy features with one password, with support for password reset.

Communication
1. Enhanced call recording: Support automatic recording for selected contacts, with optimized file naming.

System Performance
1. Reduced resource wait times in heavy-load scenarios for smoother performance.
2. Prioritized memory allocation for key apps, with intelligent background compression to free up memory.
3. Provided separate power usage breakdowns for screen-on/off and foreground/background activities, allowing you to optimize power-hungry background apps with one tap.

Cloud Services & Battery Life for Multimedia
1. Fully upgraded services to support more types of data backup and sync.

More
1. To optimize device resource usage, system stability, and the overall user experience, this version no longer supports subtly animated wallpapers. As a result, subtly animated effects will no longer play on the Lock Screen or Home Screen. If you are currently using a subtly animated wallpaper, it will revert to the default static wallpaper after the update. You can then choose and apply another wallpaper you like.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
